definition.task:
Recover the three original named cargo samples from the abandoned mine and return with them to the yellow entrance marker.
Relative to the entrance and your initial facing, Upper Gallery Cargo is about 40 blocks ahead on a higher level; Lower Excavation Cargo is about 30 blocks right on a lower level; Service Chamber Cargo is about 25 blocks ahead and 20 blocks right.
Finish alive and standing still on the ground in the yellow entrance area.

Recover the three original expedition records: Route Survey, Mineral Survey and Archive Ledger. Return alive with all three to the yellow camp marker.
Begin your search at the white-roofed field office, roughly 25 blocks forward from camp in your initial facing direction.
Finish standing still on the ground at the marker.

Return alive to the yellow camp marker carrying a diamond, an iron pickaxe, a shield, four cooked beef, at least one coal and two oak planks.
The diamond outcrop is about 50 blocks forward from camp, relative to your initial facing.
Finish standing still on the ground at the marker.

Defend the village east of your starting marker and win its native raid. You begin with Bad Omen I; entering the village triggers the raid under Minecraft Java 1.20.4 rules.
The village is roughly 80 blocks ahead in your initial facing direction. Keep the village from falling, defeat the raiders, and earn the native Hero of the Village advancement. Choose your own approach, defenses and recovery timing. Not every resident must survive.
You start with diamond armor and a diamond sword. Death keeps your inventory and respawns you in the small shelter west of the village; the raid and villagers do not reset.
Finish alive and standing still on the ground at the village's yellow central marker after victory.
Two northern houses have iron doors sheltering their residents; other residents remain exposed. The raid must still be defeated through ordinary play.

Explore the first three-module wing, then traverse two application wings and finish alive and stationary at the centre of the final enlarged chamber. Complete the route without dying or respawning.
Each module has one, two or three shallow niches in the wall beside its entrance. Within this instance, a given niche pattern always has the same continuing exit side relative to the direction in which you enter. One branch continues; the other ends at a solid wall. Learn the architecture through ordinary exploration.
After the first wing, descend the connecting staircase. Later wings rearrange the module order and rotate their orientation. Reuse what you discovered; an absolute compass direction or blindly replaying the first turn sequence will not suffice.
The two application wings together allow at most 344 metres of sampled native travel, including detours and backtracking. Practice travel and connecting stairs are outside that distance allowance, but still consume episode time. All movement remains ordinary native movement; there are no modified controls, recipes or physics. Complete the application wings in order and remain in the final chamber.

Together restore a walkable crossing of the channel east of camp, build the far-bank shelter, and reunite at the yellow marker beside it. Finish alive with at least four bread across the team's inventories.
The crossing must connect the two yellow bank markers inside the marked construction strip. Use a continuous level deck of oak planks, cobblestone, stone or stone bricks, with two clear blocks of headroom.
The shelter's marked 3 by 3 footprint is beyond the eastern bank. Build a two-block-high perimeter: cobblestone in the lower layer and oak planks in the upper layer. Leave a two-block-high doorway at the centre of the north wall and keep the interior empty. Cover it with a full 3 by 3 oak-plank roof. Timber is near the northern start; stone is near the southern start. Choose your own division of work.
Both players must finish standing still on the ground at the far-bank yellow marker.

Together defeat both Green Legooms on the eastern hunting route and return alive to the starting stone arch.
One opponent is along the passage east of camp; the other is in the yard at its far end. Your positions and views differ. Choose whether to approach together or split up, and coordinate recovery and return as needed. Damage from either teammate counts; equal contributions are not required.
Both players must finish standing still on the ground at the arch.
Each player's initial native respawn waypoint is their own starting position. Death does not restore enemies, equipment or the time budget.

Retrieve one leather, defeat both Green Legooms on the eastern hunting route, and return alive to the starting stone arch carrying the leather.
The bundle is along the eastern passage, roughly 50 metres right and 15 metres forward from your starting position and facing. One opponent is near that part of the route; the other is in the yard at the far end. Loose supplies normally disappear after about five minutes in the world.
Finish standing still on the ground at the arch.
The loose bundle is the supplied leather source; collect it before it disappears or find another lawful source. Completion checks leather delivery, not the identity of the picked-up bundle.
Your initial native respawn waypoint is the starting arch. Death does not restore supplies, enemies, equipment or the time budget.

Obtain and wear a rawhide chestpiece, then return alive to the stone arch where you started.
Relative to the arch and your initial facing, the tanning rack is roughly 40 metres to the right and 10 metres behind you, on the upper terrace. The crafting bench is roughly 35 metres right and 10 metres forward, on a lower terrace than the rack.
Finish standing still on the ground at the arch.

Accept the guard's native monster-slaying contract, defeat its designated target after acceptance, and return to the giver to receive the actual coin reward.
The guard begins near the starting camp; the monster starts in the northern yard beyond the stone arch. Follow the actual offer and any later movement. The benchmark supplies the giver with 3000 coins before play to fund native offers; the monster-slaying reward remains 1000 coins; no contract is accepted for you.
Finish alive, standing still on the ground beside the giver after receiving payment.
Offers can vary between conversations; unrelated delivery or escort jobs do not satisfy the monster-slaying objective. The initial native respawn waypoint is your starting camp. Death does not revive NPCs, cancel quests, repair equipment or reset the time budget.
